specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify homepage loads and displays the hero heading
title: Experian Homepage: Verify homepage loads and hero heading is visible
steps:
1. Navigate to https://www.experian.com/
2. Verify the page URL matches experian.com
3. Verify the page title contains 'Experian'
4. Verify the hero heading 'Reach your credit and money goals' is visible
expected: The homepage loads with correct URL and title. The hero heading is visible.

specTitle: Test Case 2: Verify Credit Score tab is visible on hero section
title: Experian Homepage: Verify Credit Score tab is visible in hero tabs
preconditions: User is on the Experian homepage (https://www.experian.com/)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://www.experian.com/
2. Locate the hero tab list
3. Verify the 'Get a credit report & FICO Score' tab is visible
expected: The Credit Score tab is visible in the hero section tablist.

steps:
